description: ol-style-name-case (issue #854): the Heritage worded reader `value of … for key` with its head written non-lowercase. Like `MAKE`, `ValueOfKey` was never in the node-kind table, so the reader was silent. Only the head `value` is reported: it is the sole literal of this production that `ast.ts` gives a span of its own, so `of`/`for`/`key` have nothing to slice the source against and stay deferred to the #115 follow-up.
